name: Fight for Paradise: Wem kannst Du trauen?
summary: The Insiders live in luxury, while the Outsiders seek a way in. All dream of a massive cash prize. Only one can win, but they can't win alone.

name: Unlocked: A Jail Experiment
summary: At an Arkansas detention facility, a sheriff implements a radical social experiment to grant men who are incarcerated more agency in this reality series.

name: How to Get to Heaven From Belfast
summary: Three lifelong friends reunite after the death of an old classmate turns a wake into a dark mystery. They embark on a thrilling adventure across Ireland, piecing together enigmatic truths amid complicated lives.

name: Warm Starry Night
summary: Lew, a famous model, struggles with amnesia following a suicide attempt brought on by heartbreak. Determined to recover her lost memories of the man she loved, she seeks solace in Chiang Khan, a tranquil Thai town where she once worked with Traipob. Pawat, a piano teacher nursing his own heartache, finds refuge in the same town. They both check into a homestay called "Lom Nao Dao Oun" and, despite initial conflicts, gradually develop feelings for each other. However, Lew's forgotten boyfriend and her mysterious nightmares complicate their journey to uncover the truth.

name: Operation: Golden Trigger
summary: Dan Niralai, an ex-detective from the Bravo Team- a secret government organization. Dan Niralai was pulled in to aid in unmasking an evil organization and taking down Prab Punyobat; a famous politician who had wrongly used his powers and is the person behind an international drug trafficking ring.

name: Maya Pissaward
summary: Many years ago, a young married couple moved to an old house. The house is filled with items and statues used to worship the snake clan especially snake queen Gorgon. The wife was so disgusted that she destroyed them all. This enraged the ancient spirits and they placed a curse on her. At that time, she was pregnant with her twin daughters. So the curse was transferred to one of them, leading her to be the next Gorgon's descendant.

name: Paen Rai Long Tai Wa Rak
summary: Fah grew up with her adopted siblings, Tawan and Dao, and they promised to always be there for each other. When Tawan is tricked into marrying Pink who is pregnant by another man, he asks Fah for help. Instead, their plan backfires and Fah winds up marrying Neung, Tawan's uncle-in-law.

name: Pompeii: The New Dig
summary: Still springing surprises. The biggest dig in a generation unearths fascinating secrets. Exciting discoveries and illuminating animations bring the ancient Roman city to life.

name: Cannabis : la série documentaire
summary: For a year, Mathieu Kassovitz and Antoine Robin investigated these countries which have chosen the legalization of cannabis: Morocco, Spain, the Netherlands, Canada, Thailand. In France, they met dealers, police officers, users... To understand this paradox: our country, where the law is the most repressive, is the one in Europe with the largest number of consumers, a third of whom are under twenty-five years old.

name: Time Team
summary: Time Team is a British archaeology series that originally broadcast on the UK's Channel 4 for 20 series, and countless specials. Over the years, the team excavated over 220 sites, from back gardens to Buckingham Palace. The show has now returned to YouTube, thanks to the incredible support of thousands of worldwide fans on Patreon.

previousepisode.name: Digging for Disney | TIME TEAM (Norton Disney) 2025

name: An Indelible Destiny
summary: Tells the story of the arrogant and cold-faced female detective Li Yiyue and the Prince of Northern Sea, Tong Ling, who met, fell in love, and forgot each other to save the common people, and then met again for the sake of justice, hated each other, fell in love, and stayed together. Three years ago, the two fell in love with each other while tracking down "Ping Ji's inner demon", but their lives were hanging by a thread in the battle with the inner demon. After the robbery, their memories were blocked. Three years later, the two united to eliminate the returning demons. Their relationship was on the verge of breaking up in order to restore their memories, but they finally eliminated the demons. In order to save Li Yiyue, who was possessed by the inner demon, Tong Ling "erased" the memories and feelings of the two people... The extraordinary skill of the iron-faced female detective of the Lone Star, the immortal who can grow dragon scales on her neck when she is shy. The combination of the most handsome and dandy prince in the palace, the "tiger" type "chivalrous heroine" and the "big" type "prince of the fairy world" is actually destined to have a red line and fate for three lives? A love like "thunder and fire" is unfolding enthusiastically this summer...

name: CBS News Roundup
summary: The CBS News team wraps up the major headlines you need to know every day on the CBS News Roundup podcast. On weekday mornings Steve Kathan delivers the "World News Roundup" and every evening you can catch up on all the day's news with Jennifer Keiper on the "World News Roundup: Late Edition". Then, every weekend the CBS News team in Washington goes deep into the major stories on "Weekend Roundup'' hosted by Allison Keyes. Each episode features a "Kaleidoscope" segment that takes on social justice issues and critical topics like race, gender, disability, income inequality, and beyond.

name: GRITtv with Laura Flanders
summary: A primetime, daily broadcast, GRITtv with Laura Flanders aired for three years on Free Speech TV before moving to KCET/Linktv and teleSUR, as a weekly program.

name: Walk with You
summary: On the day when Su Yingying, the daughter of the loyal Chief Minister Su of the Cabinet, was married to the second prince Xie Yuheng, her family was massacred by Xie Yuheng and his troops on the grounds of the Chief Minister Su's alleged treason. Xie Yuheng thus ascended to the position of the crown prince. Three years later, Su Yingying returns to clear her father's name and uncover the truth behind the treason case. Teaming up with the seventh prince, Xie Yi'an, she disguises herself as Xie Yi'an's maid, Suying. Starting from the counterfeit banknote case, they discover its connection to Chief Minister Su and Xie Yuheng, prompting them to go deepe

name: The Eternal Fragrance
summary: When the Sea Calamity strikes and the Divine Tree appears, whoever claims its fruit gains power over all creation, sparking a bloody war among the immortals, demons, and monsters. A century later, Lei Xiuyuan seeks out Qingqiu orphan Xiaobangchui to save his brother. Fate brings them to Chufeng Academy, where loyal friends give Xiaobangchui warmth and love between Lei and her begins to bloom. As their bond deepens, the truth of her origin slowly unravels, threatening everything they've built.

name: Laura Flanders & Friends
summary: Interviews and investigative reporting on the people and movements driving positive systemic change.

name: The Laura Flanders Show
summary: Weekly in-depth interviews with forward-thinking people in the worlds of arts, entrepreneurship and politics.

name: Champions: Full Gallop
summary: Champions: Full Gallop gets a back stage pass to the lives of jockeys and trainers at some of the best Jumps fixtures, including the iconic Cheltenham Festival and world famous Grand National - some of the most dramatic sporting events on earth. Millions of people will be watching, millions of pounds will be bet and millions more will be up for grabs in prize money.

name: How Disney Built America
summary: How Disney Built America explores the history of Walt Disney and how the iconic Disney brand, fueled by the creation of beloved characters, cherished family films, thrilling theme parks, technological innovations, and more, continues to shape generations as a cultural and worldwide phenomenon.

name: Pim Mala
summary: Priew is a playboy that captures the heart of Namnuan, the niece of his boss. She is a sweet and innocent lady. When she discovers how much of a playboy he is, she is saddened and leaves the country to study abroad. When she returns to work for her aunt's company, Priew is attracted to her new looks and attitude. However, Namnuan is already engaged to Waen. One day, an angel transforms Priew into a woman named Pim Mala. The angel wants to teach him a lesson about the feelings of women. She promises to return him to his male body when he ends his playboy behavior.

name: Yo Gabba GabbaLand!
summary: Yo Gabba GabbaLand! invites audiences to explore a magical world of endless possibilities and promise with friends both familiar and new, in a reimagining that brings to life an expansive Yo Gabba GabbaLand. Filled with optimism and fun, kids and families are taught life lessons through song and dance that allow them to learn, laugh and grow together.

name: The Full Irish Hidden Camera Show
summary: Doireann, Donncha and Carl are on the road ready to prank the unsuspecting people of Ireland in the Full Irish Hidden Camera Show!

name: Chamak
summary: After returning to Punjab from Canada, an aspiring young rapper learns that his father, a legendary singer, was shot dead during a performance along with his mother. He steers his way through the underbelly of the Punjab music industry, politics and business feuds with a fierce determination to unmask his parents' killer.

name: Dr. Arora
summary: Set in the year 1999 AD, Dr. Arora is a curious comedy on the life and times of a sex consultant and his patients in the towns of Jhansi, Morena, and Sawai Madhopur. His profession, seemingly unique to the locals, results in serendipitous encounters that lead to unexpected enmities and unlikely friendships.

name: Potluck
summary: Persuaded by the family patriarch, the Shastris come together for weekly Potluck meals, albeit reluctantly. Set in upper-middle-class Mumbai, each episode is a comical potpourri of opinions, conflicts, dilemmas and unsaid assumptions as the Shastri's try hard to believe, "the family that eats together, stays together." But do they really?

name: Adrishyam: The Invisible Heroes
summary: Adrishyam: The Invisible Heroes is an espionage thriller series following the life of undercover intelligence officers of the Bharat Intelligence Agency. The agents, Ravi and Parvati, track and neutralize terror risks to protect the nation while posing as regular employees of the meteorological department.

name: Raisinghani vs Raisinghani
summary: Raisinghani vs Raisinghani focuses on a sharp-witted young lawyer making her mark in her father's law firm, a suave and driven contender and a young intern harbouring a dark secret as their lives intricately weave together at a law firm in a legal tale of ambition and intrigue. The riveting courtroom drama explores moral dilemmas and the choice of the right over easy.

name: Raised by the Village
summary: As the saying goes "it takes a village to raise a child". But can two tight knit Irish rural communities help a pair of city teens get their lives back on track?

name: Brave The Darkness: The Breakthrough Girl
Wildlife Rescue
summary: Series following the dedicated team at South Essex Wildlife Hospital as they tend to the needs of sick, injured and orphaned animals.

name: BGT Reacts
summary: Join our famous faces reacting to this week's Britain's Got Talent. Expect fun-filled games, awesome talent, hilarious judge comments and OMG! moments.

name: The 8 Show
summary: Eight strangers with unique stories join a show taking place in an eight-story building where they must entertain an invisible crowd to win prize money.

name: Кресло
summary: Misha's life was not going well. Overnight he lost his girlfriend, his job and his confidence in the future. Having bought a chair on Avito, he finds inside a folder with documents and a huge amount of money belonging to the right hand of the city governor. Thinking about what to do with the find, Mikhail begins to little by little correct the communal shortcomings in the yard, which earns the respect of the residents and the status of a people's deputy. However, the governor discovers that documents are missing, and elections are coming soon in the city. Will popular love and a mysterious folder help Misha take the governor's chair?

name: Massacre of the Mormons
summary: This four-part docuseries explores the harrowing 2019 killing of three women and six children from a Mormon community in Sonora, Mexico.

name: Tia Mowry: My Next Act
summary: Tia Mowry: My Next Act, a docuseries that dives head-first into the post-divorce, new-lease-on-life universe of multi-talented, Tia Mowry. The series delivers unprecedented access to behind-the-scenes ongoings of Tia's multifaceted life. We'll join her as she navigates her newly single status, motherhood, building businesses and juggling her super busy and ever-evolving career. Tia is ready to date, take her multiple businesses to the next level, and discover what makes her happy. With this exciting new chapter comes profound changes and adjustments to the roles Tia plays in her everyday life, and her next act.

name: Dead in the Water
summary: A young British couple's dream trip through remote Central America, turns into a chilling nightmare when they are brutally murdered and the trail for their killer goes cold. Four decades later, failed by law enforcement, their family take up the manhunt and make a shocking discovery.

name: Fai Nai Wayu
summary: Wayu is the eldest son and heir of a wealthy family. His stepmother and her own son conspire to take over the estate. They make Wayu believe that he has killed his own brother. Wayu in an attempt to escape guilt, runs away only to end up at a nearby farm. The only daughter of the farm Lukwha treats him with kindness and sincerity. Together they work through what happened the night his brother died.

name: Love in Disguise
summary: When fate causes a young superstar to disguise herself to escape death. Transform into the ugliest woman in the three worlds. Accidentally met the man of my dreams who once broke my heart. romantic story Dik Dik Dik, fun, brutal, funny, crazy was born.

name: Kol Ruk Luang Jai
summary: Bua comes from a wealthy, Chinese-Thai family in the soy sauce industry. Her mom is constantly longing for respect within the hi-so community and forces Bua to marry Chatchai, a man who could get them there. Bua is a sweet person but cannot fathom marrying a man she does not love and barely knows, so she and her best friend Cartoon try to find a way out. Coincidentally, they overhear her brother Petch talking on the phone with his friend Ran—Bua's childhood crush—who is in need of a woman to masquerade as his girlfriend! This inspired the duo to formulate a plan.

name: The Folly of Human Ambition
summary: Sorawart is an ambitious man who tries to try to raise his standard of living by pleasing his boss, who controls his career, and by seducing Withu, a lonely divorcée. Can he eventually achieve his goals? That remains to be seen.

name: I Am Solo: Love Forever
summary: Who found a happily ever after and who's still happily searching? Cast members from "I'm SOLO" reveal what happened in their lives after the show aired.

name: Operación Barrio Inglés
summary: Huelva becomes the Spanish Casablanca, a true nest of spies from both sides, among whom young Lucía is forced to move. The protagonist has just turned 25 years old and has been hired by an English mining company to work in its offices as a secretary. There she meets the company manager, Peter, an attractive Englishman with a dark past who drags Lucía into an adventure in which she will be forced to take sides. When you're in the middle of a war, being neutral is not an option.

name: Khun Mae Kaekhat
summary: Arunrada decide to blackmail Pathiharn, the man she has just met, for 500K baht, because her sister needs money very badly. Aware of her trick, he gives her an offer to be the mother of his son whose mother, Pimrada, has gone missing for 5 years. While she's being a fake mother for Pathiharn's son, they develop romantic feelings for each other. However, his wife who was missing, finally returns.

name: Love Naggers
summary: A panel of love experts weigh in on romantic relationships from the quirky to the scandalous, combing over text messages and delighting in re-enactments.

name: The Lost City of Ramses II
summary: Ramses the Great is one of the most emblematic pharaohs of Ancient Egypt, who saw in the construction of the city of Pi-Ramses a way to reach power. Professor Henning Franzmeier and his team have recently discovered a splendid palace and treasure room inside the city walls. This documentary follows this unprecedented mission for eight weeks and reveals for the first time the true history of the lost city of Ramses the Great.

name: Royal Rules of Ohio
summary: Royal Rules of Ohio follows three Ghanaian sisters as they navigate their twenties in Columbus, Ohio. The Agyekum sisters live a lavish life as the daughters of royal descendants of two of the most wealthy and powerful Ghanaian kingdoms. However, with that privilege comes great responsibility. Behind closed doors, viewers are given a glimpse into the double lives the sisters are living that could tarnish their family's noble reputation.

name: Eye on America
summary: Featuring stories on Americans who are solving a range of challenges in creative ways.

name: Person to Person with Norah O'Donnell
summary: Norah O'Donnell sits down with authors, celebrities, athletes, and politicians so viewers can get to know newsmakers in an entirely new light.

name: Person to Person with Charlie Rose & Lara Logan
summary: On December 15, 2011, CBS News announced they would bring back the news series with Charlie Rose and Lara Logan as hosts.

previousepisode.name: Sean Penn, Alicia Keys, and Drew Brees

name: Person to Person with Edward R. Murrow & Charles Collingwood
summary: Interviews with figures from public life.

name: The Uplift
summary: Anchor Tony Dokoupil spotlights stories that inspire, motivate and tug at the heartstrings.

name: The Takeout with Major Garrett
summary: The Takeout is a weekly podcast about politics, policy and pop culture hosted by CBS News Chief White House Correspondent Major Garrett; analysis of the week's political news in a casual format that allows for expanded conversation with a newsmaker.

name: CBS MoneyWatch
summary: The latest financial news, headlines and analysis from CBS MoneyWatch.

name: Here Comes the Sun
summary: Here Comes The Sun, anchored by Tracy Smith and Lee Cowan, takes a closer look at some of the people, places and things we bring you every weekend on Sunday Morning.

name: Laver pour gagner
summary: Laver pour gagner is THE most entertaining cleaning competition in Quebec. Equipped with rags and soap, 16 candidates will have to eliminate all stains and dirt, make mess and mess disappear, to shine towards victory.

name: El Rey del Cachopo: César Román
summary: The rise to fame of a charismatic chef known as the "King of Cachopo" becomes his downfall when his girlfriend's dismembered body is found.

name: Jamie's Air Fryer Meals
summary: Jamie Oliver shows us how to elevate our culinary credentials with the latest kitchen craze, as he brings us some delicious dishes and innovative ways to make the most of our air fryers.

name: Горький 53
summary:
The year is 1953. Due to the mass amnesty, the criminal situation in the USSR is tense. At the same time, Ivan Astafyev, a former commander of a reconnaissance platoon, who was released from prison, returns to his hometown of Gorky. And immediately becomes a victim of an attack by bandits, and then a false accusation of beating the attackers. Ivan's pre—war acquaintance, Captain Shvedov, helps out of trouble, who gets him a job at the Dynamo sports society to train policemen in hand-to-hand combat.

But it does not work out to lead a peaceful life: Ivan is drawn into a cycle of violent crimes, in one of which his brother and his wife are killed. Astafyev is again under suspicion. He is forced to make a secret deal with the police, organize an ostentatious escape and demand to infiltrate Gorky's most powerful gang. The hero must trap its leader Khariton, rid the city of crime and finally regain his life.

name: Padomju džinsi
summary: At the end of the seventies, when anti-Western propaganda was raging in the USSR, a rock and roll fan managed to create an underground jeans production network in a psychiatric hospital in Latvia.

name: An Hour to Kill
summary: An Hour to Kill follows a single homicide, examining the most fascinating consecutive 60 minutes of a case. This could be the time in the court which results in a guilty verdict, the key times of a manhunt which leads to a capture, or the hour just before the murder is committed...

name: WNBA Countdown
summary: WNBA Countdown serves as the primer for game telecasts on both ESPN2 and ESPN. It features a less-scripted format, highlighted by a lively round-table discussion and debate of the top story lines around the league.

name: Danny Dyer: How to Be a Man
summary: With traditional gender roles a thing of the past, what does it mean to be a man in modern-day Britain? Danny Dyer explores modern masculinity, men's mental health and male identity.

name: CBS News Latest Headlines
summary: The latest headlines and top stories from CBS News.

name: CBS News Weekender
summary: Stream CBS News Weekender every Friday at 7PM ET/PT on CBSNews.com and the CBS News app.

name: CBS News Daily Headlines
summary: The latest headlines and top stories from CBS News.

name: CBS News Confirmed
summary: CBS News Confirmed, premiering this summer, is described as an effort to identify and report on misinformation. It is part of an entire unit bearing the same name as an effort to help viewers sort fact from fiction.

name: Bergerac
summary: Bergerac will honour the iconic detective drama, but with a contemporary twist, as Bergerac thrown into a knotty, high-stakes police investigation and challenged to his very core. He will be forced to confront his demons, while trying to save his family and career.

name: Bookish
summary: In London 1946, the appropriately named Gabriel Book opens the doors to Book's Books on Archangel Lane for more thrilling cases for his team to solve. If his War was packed with espionage and secrets, Book's Peace is just as full of adventure! Now he helps police solve the strangest of crimes and the knottiest of murders.

name: In Suspicious Circumstances
summary: Series of drama-documentaries depicting crimes from the past.

name: The Ultimatum: South Africa
summary: Six South African couples swap partners to test their love in a daring experiment, traversing twists and uncovering truths that challenge their futures.

name: Bellas Artes
summary: Antonio Dumas, a prestigious art historian and cultural manager, cultured and sophisticated, although quite cynical and conceited, is appointed director of an important contemporary art museum in Madrid, after emerging victorious in a competition for that position. Once he has assumed his new position, he must face, in the midst of the unusual fauna of the art world, a range of disparate circumstances and conflicts: from union problems and political pressures, to crazy situations in relation to exhibitions and artists.

name: Selgeltnägijate tuleproov
summary: The hit show that made waves all over Estonia is back on the screen! Ten people who claim to have psychic abilities are tested with various tasks right in front of the television viewers. Whether it's finding a missing person, describing what happened at a crime scene, or something even more crazy, the contestants can only rely on their extraordinary abilities. The performance of these incredible tasks is monitored by Estonia's leading skeptics and experts, including academics, criminalists, celebrities and investigative journalists. Their task is to exclude any fraud and collusion. At the end of each part, the sensitive with the fewest points must leave the competition.

name: Care Bears: Adventures in Care-a-lot
summary: The animated adventures of the friendly bears who teach lessons while having fun.

name: Metropolitan Opera: Live in HD
summary: Performances from the Metropolitan Opera.

name: Big Russian Lies
summary: A series of documentaries that demonstrate the continuing influence of the so-called Russian cultural diplomacy as a real propaganda tool, particularly in the fields of history, cinema, literature, sports, media, and art. The project about the limits of Russian propaganda was commissioned by Suspilne Kultura TV channel and produced by the team of individual entrepreneur Andriy Yeremin.

previousepisode.name: «Нейтральні» спортсмени «В ПОГОНАХ»?! Як Росія повертається в спорт

name: X Factor Georgia
summary: X Factor Georgia is the Georgian version of The X Factor, a show originating from the United Kingdom. It is a television music talent show featuring aspiring singers of all genres drawn from auditions from all across Georgia.

name: Hunting Mr Nice: The Cannabis Kingpin
summary:
Hunting Mr Nice: The Cannabis Kingpin tells the story of Howard Marks, who grew up in a Welsh village, dabbled in dealing weed while at Oxford university, before building a worldwide drug-smuggling empire and even working for MI6, at the height of the America's War on Drugs. For decades, the audacious and charismatic ‘Mr Nice' managed to evade prosecution before his luck finally ran out, serving time in high security US prisons before ultimately writing a bestselling book and campaigning for the decriminalisation of marijuana. 

This new insight tells the definitive story of the world's most notorious cannabis smuggler – and the police who devoted their lives to bringing him to justice, along with members of his criminal inner circle breaking their silence for the very first time. Also featuring journalists, lawyers and Marks' friends, the series takes us inside the cultural phenomenon of ‘Mr Nice' to ask how he was able to become so criminally famous yet continue to evade justice.

name: Chris Cooks Cymru
summary: In Chris Cooks Cymru fire-chef extraordinaire, Chris 'Flamebaster' Roberts, will take his passion on the road across his beloved Wales. Hooking up with renowned chefs, producers and local characters he will be showcasing top foodie destinations and cooking his go-to dishes along the way. Whether it's next-level restaurants, the local kebab house food trucks - he's all about celebrating Welsh food, Welsh producers and Welsh communities from stunning Welsh backdrops to urban cookouts that bring whole communities together.

name: The Perfect Prince Loves Me, the Side Character?!
summary:
Side Character — Unimportant. Constantly getting in the way of the main characters' love story.
After finding himself reincarnated into the world of a novel, Loneal goes to great lengths to steer clear of Prince Alec, the hero, to avoid disrupting the main storyline between Alec and the heroine, Lily. However, to Loneal's great surprise, the prince becomes infatuated with...him?!
"A charming physique, such as yours, more than makes up for your lack of experience."
Before he knows it, he finds himself melting into the prince's arms... Why is everything so different from the novel?!

name: Mémoire Vive
summary: The series tells the story of Esther Lefèvre, a retired court clerk. But when she is diagnosed with early-stage Alzheimer's, a secret she had tried to bury deep in her memory resurfaces. She pulls a list of names from her archives and begins to eliminate, one by one, the people mentioned on it, transforming into an enigmatic and clumsy vigilante.

name: In the Eye of the Storm: The Political Odyssey of Yanis Varoufakis
summary: In the Eye of the Storm is a six-part documentary series about one of the foremost intellectuals and political figures of our age, Yanis Varoufakis. In the Eye of the Storm begins with a first-hand account of Varoufakis' dramatic battle with the European establishment, but goes much further to weave a gripping political narrative about the fate of our civilization: where we are, how we got here, and where he believes we must go.

previousepisode.name: Sow the Seeds of the Next Renaissance

name: Play!
summary: Explore playtime for children in different locations around the world.

name: Upin & Ipin
summary: The series centres on a pair of 5-year-old twin boys, the titular Upin and Ipin, who tell stories of their everyday lives through fun and amusing actions with their friends while also learning new things during their day to day activities. Like every other children, Upin and Ipin are very mischievous and often find themselves getting into trouble, most of the time with their teenage sister Ros.

name: Склиф
summary: Traumatologist Evgenia Pokrovskaya is an aspiring specialist in a predominantly male team. When she was still a student, she started dating Roma, but now they have little in common. Roman's father got him a job as a surgeon in his department, and his more talented Wife had to put in a lot of effort to get the coveted position. Being a perfectionist, she strives to develop her career and carry out more complex operations. But Zhenya is surrounded by skeptical colleagues, and the girl will have to work hard to gain their respect.

name: Faithless
summary: Co-written by and starring Baz Ashmawy, this brand new comedic and tantalizingly honest drama series follows Irish-Egyptian dad, Sam, who is presented with the life altering responsibility of raising his three young daughters alone. That is until his irresponsible yet irresistible younger brother moves in to help... and never leaves!

name: Preston Pig
summary: Children's animated series about a football-crazy piglet.

name: Похищение
summary: A woman escapes her kidnapper but her son remains missing. As another disappearance occurs, the investigator discovers a tenant holding a "family" captive, collecting them for an eerie childhood vision.

name: Bit Playas
summary: Bit Playas follows Ahmed and Leon as they spend their days hustling in the casting room, working jobs in the real world, deflecting the occasional "soft racism" and dealing with their own identity crises.

name: Roll No. 21
summary: Kris, the incarnation of Lord Krishna is an intelligent and naughty orphan with magical powers who wreaks havoc with his friends Pinky and Babloo. To save his friends from evil zombie demons and he uses his superpowers to keep everyone safe.

name: Friedefeld
summary:
The "half triplets" Barbie, Paul and Ludwig juggle their everyday family madness together. Born to three different women on the same day, they are inextricably linked by father Gerd's involuntary, perfectly timed contraceptive failures.

Paul is the king of procrastinating. Every day he resolves to change his life, but something keeps getting in the way. Be it budding feelings for his ex Berthe, the constant best buddy advances of her new lover Jan or an urgent series episode - Paul always has an excuse ready.

But luckily there is half-sister Barbie, a determined top manager with significantly more balls in her pants, and half-brother Ludwig, a lifer who avoids work like the devil avoids holy water. He constantly intrudes on Paul and drives him crazy.

name: Code R
summary: The adventures of the fire, police & rescue departments of California's Channel Island.

name: 1992: Wielka Gra
summary: The extraordinary journey of Poland's 1992 Olympic football team, from local clubs to Olympic glory, rewriting a new chapter in their nation's sports history.

name: Aamodt Kilde
summary: Join the high-stakes of world renowned alpinist Aleksander Aamodt Kilde, as he chases victory and navigates his personal relationship with fellow skiing prodigy, Mikaela Shiffrin.

name: Cody Gakpo | Psalm 20:4
summary: With a soaring career and high-stakes transfers, Cody Gakpo's journey from Eredivisie to Liverpool FC reveals the pressures of elite football and his devotion to faith and family.

name: Halva halva
summary: In Halva halva, we follow the Iraqi Massari family on their journey to find a new home when gentrification forces them out of their apartment in the Stockholm suburbs. While facing numerous external pressures socially, culturally, and economically, as well as those that come with moving, the infighting begins as previously held grievances are aired between the family members.

name: Human to Human
summary: Journey into the heart of conflict, witnessing the intertwined fates of Ukrainian refugees and the Polish allies standing by them, as they navigate the aftermath of the Ukraine war.

name: Tytani KSW
summary: Meet KSW legends Mamed Khalidov and Mariusz Pudzianowski, as well as young newcomers Sebastian Rajewski and Salahdine Parnasse, who are predicted to become stars in MMA.

name: Мосгаз. Дело № 10. Метроном
summary:
The year is 1982. Sonya Timofeeva, Alexey Garkusha and Egor Osadchy are now on their own, and ambitious Major Viktor Kovalev is trying to take the empty place of the head of the task force.

Meanwhile, in Moscow, Andrei Grinyakin, a well-known pop artist and employee of the Moscow Concert, dies right during the performance. Everything indicates that someone is trying to "hush up" this case. Sonya Timofeeva, in secret from everyone, begins to conduct her own investigation. Kovalev is also trying to understand what is happening in the Moscow Concert. It is obvious that the underground activities of Mosconcert are covered by influential people.

Events are unfolding rapidly: one by one, the participants in the criminal scheme of the director of the Mosconcert Olshevsky are killed.

name: Girls on Fire
summary: "Girls on Fire", a third edition to the shows "Phantom Singer" and "Super Band", a competition consisting of only female main vocalist material to create a new vocal group dominating a "NEW KPOP" genre, creating a strong vocal group such as MAMAMOO. Girls On Fire means 'passionate and cool women', represents so-called 'women who know how to have fun' who enjoy the stage with their own music style.

name: MILF of Norway
summary: The spark in Lene's marriage is long gone and when she suddenly loses her job at a prestigious advertisement agency, she feels lost and humiliated, wondering what to do next. One drunken night, she posts a scantily clad picture of herself wearing a traditional folk costume - mostly as a joke - on the website InsideFans. Lene soon realizes there is a niche audience out there who are thirsty for more and willing to pay for it.

name: Avskalat
summary: In this show, we'll meet some of Sweden's most interesting and sought-after celebrities. The set up is simple - an empty stage, Pär Johansson and a mega famous person talking about life and what comes with it. Pär has a unique way of interviewing which encourages his guests to open up and share tales never told before.

name: Mafia
summary:
The stark transformation of 1990s Sweden from peaceful to perilous as it follows the ascent of Radovan "Jakov" Jakovic from rags to criminal riches and Gunn Philak, the lone cop who sees the looming mafia menace in cigarette smuggling's shadow.

Mafia is a six-episode crime series, drawing inspiration from actual events. It unfolds the transformation of Sweden in the 1990s, evolving from a relatively tranquil nation untouched by organised crime into a land marked by intense gang conflicts and violent shootouts. The series also delves into the life of the notorious gangster Radovan "Jakov" Jakovic, chronicling his journey from poverty to wealth.

Against Jakov is a police officer called Gunn Philak, a dedicated officer who recognises that the income from cigarette smuggling will build a full-fledged mafia in Sweden. However, her battle isn't limited to combating an infamous criminal gang; she also finds herself at odds with her own law enforcement agency, which fails to grasp the gravity of her perspective. Gunn faces a total lack of understanding regarding her belief that the cigarette trade should be treated with greater seriousness than armed bank robberies.

Mafia touches on a critical time in Swedish history, the consequences of which still echo today. The series takes viewers back to a time when acts of violence such as shootings were unusual, almost unthinkable, but where cigarette smuggling, in particular, became the prelude to a new type of organised crime.

name: Mitt liv som Lasse Hallström
summary: Delve into Lasse's illustrious career, witnessing the magic behind "Hilma", and hear tales from his legendary collaborations.

name: Bendtner
summary: Trace the extraordinary journey of football prodigy Nicklas, as he rises to a premier club at 16 but grapples with personal demons that shadow his career. With unprecedented access, witness his highs and lows.

name: Solo
summary: Talented young individuals confront challenges and distractions as they chase their dreams in Norway's vibrant arts scene. With rivalries intensifying and passions flaring, these artists must find their place, voice, and purpose.

name: The Stroke
summary: Jacek is a foodie, gay and Warsaw bon vivant who has his own TV show, several similarly eccentric close ones around him and self-destructive tendencies. A dramedy that makes fun of the Polish artistic elite, for whom Warsaw is "the only real Polish city", cannot be compared to other shows. It is the authorial work of playwright and screenwriter Pawel Demirski. He wrote it from the beginning with the intention of presenting a hero contrasting with the burnout syndrome often felt today – a vital madman who believes the best is yet to come.

name: The Real Line of Duty
summary: The Real Line of Duty tells the story of an undercover police unit set up to crack the cycle of corruption that engulfed the Met in the 90s, and the brave officers who fought for justice from within.

name: Bangers & Cash: Under the Bonnet
summary: Bangers & Cash: Under the Bonnet – revealing previously unseen footage to give viewers a deeper insight into the stories behind some of the cars that have featured on the Bangers & Cash and Bangers & Cash Restoring Classics programmes.

name: My Bungalow Bliss
summary: Hugh Wallace sees four innovative architects, paired with four first time bungalow homeowners, who are desperately seeking a home makeover.

name: Stories from the Land
summary: The Stories from the Land short doc-series picks up where the podcast leaves off, and reaches across Indigenous communities to paint a picture of Indigenous identity through global themes of humanity.

name: A Very Royal Crisis: Countdown to Abdication
summary: This is the true tale of the biggest scandal ever to engulf the British Royal Family. A forbidden love affair, which had a devastating impact. This new three-part documentary series recounts the story behind the ten days leading to Edward VIII abdicating his throne to marry American divorcee Wallis Simpson. It would change the royals, the press and British history forever.

name: Kimler Geldi Kimler Geçti
summary: After a painful breakup, a young lawyer dives head first into the confusing world of modern dating, with the unwavering support of her best friends.

name: Rwina
summary: The hopeless friends Sinan, Danny and Leroy spend their days hanging out on the street, eating döner and hitting on chicks, until Sinan falls in love with Hannah, the girlfriend of their arch-enemy Tabaka. While Tabaka hunts for the boys on his horse, Sinan tries to win over the love of his life. And so the boys roll from one bizarre adventure to another.

name: Alyssa's Secret: The ReBOOT
summary: Ten years ago, fresh off the set of RuPaul's Drag Race Season 5, Alyssa Edwards started sharing secrets in the studio at World of Wonder. After a decade of foolishness and tomfoolery, it's time to get back to the basics. Alyssa's Secret: The ReBOOT is a revamp of the OG series we fell in love with a decade ago. In each episode, Alyssa will share her secret to a variety of topics, such as: keeping calm, feeling seductive and her secret to a healthy, happy day. The ReBOOT would not be complete without a surprise celebrity guest! Tune in every Wednesday to WOW Presents Plus starting April 26, because if it ain't broke, don't fix it… remix it!

name: Kerri Kares
summary: In her new original series Kerri Kares, RuPaul's Drag Race Season 14 standout Kerri Colby shares her secrets to living her best life. Talking candidly about numerous topics including confidence, relationships, transitioning, coming out and self-care, Kerri and her celebrity guests dish out advice with a sense of humor. We're all ears!

name: Manhattan Cable
summary: Love, Connie hosts a series produced by World of Wonder in the early 90s. Take a bite out of the Big Apple with the wildest clips from New York's public access channels, and see exclusive interviews with Manhattan's most famous, fierce, and freaky! Don't touch that dial - it's Manhattan Cable!

name: Click Boys
summary: This intimate and revealing 5-part docu-series follows LGBTQIA adult content creators who make their income through the internet subscription service OnlyFans. We peek behind the curtain to show the real life triumphs and struggles of our Click Boys as they make a healthy living. Discussing queer and cultural identity, body positivity, the business of sex work and sexual freedom, these boys reveal all - in more ways than one.

name: Jasmine Masters' Class
summary: Etiquette! Propriety! Welcome to Jasmine Masters' Class!

name: Puff Puff Sessions
summary: Langanja Estranja shares the benefits of Marijuana while getting blazed with some of her best Judys!

name: Godzilla Island
summary: Godzilla and friends have been rounded up on monster island. They protect the island from evil monsters such as King Ghidorah and Mechagodzilla.

name: Junior MasterChef: Swaad Ke Ustaad
summary: This reality show is a platform for kids to showcase their culinary skills. It includes some of the youngest chefs who will churn out mouth-watering dishes.

name: Hollywood Con Queen
summary: A mysterious figure—known as the Con Queen—is impersonating powerful female executives in Hollywood, luring victims with the promise of life-changing career opportunities. A journalist and a private investigator set out to find the culprit behind the scam.

name: Star vs Food: Survival
summary: Celebrities make mouthwatering dishes by foraging the Indian wilderness.

name: My Mum, Your Dad NZ
summary: A group of single Kiwi parents move into a house together, hoping to find a second chance at love. But there's a twist - little do they know that their adult kids are watching their every move and trying to help them succeed.

name: Murders at Little Bridge Farm
summary:
Murders at Little Bridge Farm tells the shocking story of Mark Brown, and the double life the self-proclaimed 'psychopath with a conscience' led. A family man by day and sadistic killer by night, convicted, in December 2022, of murdering Alex Morgan, 34, and Leah Ware, 32.

The two-part special will use archive footage, CCTV, police evidence and interviews with the victims' families to piece together this complex investigation. It reveals how Brown laid a false trail for police, in a desperate bid to prevent them finding the horrific truth hidden at Little Bridge Farm. This exclusive commission for Crime + Investigation details the timeline and explores what happened to piece together the evidence of these two horrific murders that took place in St Leonards, Hastings. It gets to the truth of what happened to two doting mothers with everything to live for and the monster who killed them.

name: Ghost Ships
summary: The seafloor of the Atlantic is littered with mysteries, prompting professional salvage diver Tony Sampson and his team to brave the shifting currents and bone-chilling legends of Nova Scotia in search of answers.

name: Damon Runyon Theater
summary: An anthology series based primarily on the stories of author Damon Runyon.

name: Milkshake! Secret Life of the Forest
summary: A fascinating exploration of some of the many plants, insects and animals of the forest.

name: Подростки в космосе
summary: The year is 2054. The Earth is literally suffocating: due to environmental problems, the average age of the population is rapidly decreasing. Teenagers can save the situation - the only ones who are physically capable of going into space and finding a unique substance to prevent a catastrophe. Of the 13 daredevils, each with their own personal motives, only six will make it onto the crew.

name: Elkhorn
summary: Theodore Roosevelt is bound for greatness—he's a Harvard graduate from a prominent family, a rising politician, and his wife, Alice, is pregnant. Then his promising future turns tragic. His mother succumbs to typhoid, and Alice dies in childbirth on the same day. Devastated, Teddy leaves his urban world of high rises and high society for the desolate Dakota Territory, where, by facing the harsh reality of surviving life on America's frontier, he intends to remake himself into something greater.

name: Tinderfesten
summary: Fetisha and her friends date strangers on TV, with several disputes and surprises along the way.

name: The Anonymous
summary:
The Anonymous is a game of social strategy where people are free to say what they really feel behind the safety of a mask.  What would you say and do if nobody was watching you?

It is played in two worlds: the real world, where players interact face to face, but also a digital world, where the players communicate behind a mask of anonymity, known as Anonymous Mode. Here in individual private hideouts, each player is free to say whatever they want to advance their game.

The question is: Can they stay anonymous or will the other players guess their identity causing them to lose their power in the game?

name: Ni una más
summary: Alma is 17 years old and is about to finish high school. Greta and Nata are her two best friends; they have known each other since they were little, they party together and face the typical issues of their age: feeling left out, jealousy, problems with their parents, and even toxic relationships... But when the profile @Iam_colemanmiller publishes a photo with the caption "This is me the day before I was raped", normality disappears and everything changes. How and when did this assault happen? Who is behind this profile? How much truth is there in this accusation and who is the real victim?

name: Erica
summary: Erica Faure, 41, is a successful writer of detective novels. Returning to her hometown to empty the house of her deceased parents, she discovers the lifeless body of Alexandra, her childhood best friend, with her veins cut. Convinced that it is not a suicide, Erica launches into an investigation where past and present intertwine. However, it is above all his meeting with Captain Patrick Saab that will turn his life upside down.

name: Экстрасенсы. Битва сильнейших
summary: Best of the best will show their strength and esoteric skills. Once they have already proved what they are capable of. But can the best stay that way among the strongest? In each edition, the participants will be tested, and the jury members, the audience and the psychics themselves will determine those who did it better, and who should continue to practice their skills. For the first time, psychics will undergo a "three-step" assessment of their abilities, in which TNT viewers will play an important role. In each issue, they will be able to decide who was the best and worthy.

name: Who's Afraid of a Cheap Old House?
summary: Who's Afraid of a Cheap Old House? will take potential buyers on tours of two listings—from traditional styles such as Colonial Revival, Craftsman, Tudor and Queen Anne to out-of-the-box ones like a church and a firehouse—that are brimming with history and unique architecture.

name: Full Court Press
summary: Full Court Press chronicles the ongoing journeys of senior Iowa guard Caitlin Clark, senior South Carolina center Kamilla Cardoso and sophomore UCLA guard Kiki Rice. From Iowa's historic preseason game that broke attendance records all the way through the WNBA draft in April, the series uses unparalleled access, exclusive interviews, and unique game footage, to transport audiences into the lives of these exceptional athletes. Full Court Press follows them as they steer their celebrated programs towards a national championship, all while navigating the pressures that come with representing the game during a pivotal era in women's basketball.

name: Are You Smarter Than a Celebrity?
summary: Contestants play for the chance to win up to $100,000 by answering questions about things they learned in grade school. There's a classroom full of celebrities they can get help from -- including Nikki Glaser, Nicole Byer, Lala Kent, Ryan Fitzpatrick and more! Can they ace grades 1 through 5 for a chance to play for the big money? Or will they flunk out along the way? It's time to find out!

name: Down Cemetery Road
summary: When a house explodes in a quiet Oxford suburb and a girl disappears in the aftermath, neighbor Sarah Trafford becomes obsessed with finding her and enlists the help of private investigator Zoë Boehm. Zoë and Sarah suddenly find themselves in a complex conspiracy that reveals that people long believed dead are still among the living, while the living are fast joining the dead.

name: Manndag
summary: Six men fight against themselves and their surroundings in small everyday trials. As you know, the simple is often the worst.

name: Jons indre med Jon Sindre
summary: Welcome to Jons indre! There will be music, chaos and romance with a wall. Plus more than a few hopeless types. Sketch series with Jon Sindre Fjellvang.

name: Ikke tenk på meg
summary: Too much eye contact? A little too happy for a compliment? Meet unusual people struggling to figure out how much space they can take up. Sketch series with Mathea Josefsen.

name: Studio Stuve
summary: A hard-hitting news program that only deals with the most important issues - in a way. Sketch series with Amalie Stuve.

name: Drømmen om EM
summary: The national football team failed to take Norway to the EC – again. What happened? Morten Ramm and Erik Solbakken get close to get answers from the players.

name: Nytt blod
summary: The family at Langedrag is facing a shift - if mum lets go. Can daughter Marie manage to take over the throne in Norway's largest nature park?

name: Sønner av Norden
summary: They are critical of immigration and want to keep the Nordics "white". Nordic nationalists say they will fight to defend their values - if only with violence.

name: Michael Portillo's Long Weekends
summary:
Join Michael Portillo as he takes us on a Long Weekend to three of his favourite European cities: Madrid, Prague and Milan.

On each Long Weekend Michael reveals the secrets, sites and people that make these cities tick, finding the best restaurants, bars, food markets and hotels, as well as the places only the locals know and love. Exploring hidden neighbourhoods off the tourist trail, and going behind-the-scenes of major landmarks he reveals how in just a busy weekend you can find the real city as well as the classic Royal palaces, cathedrals, galleries, and museums, which open their doors and welcome us all in.

In each city Michael meets up with locals with a particular connection to that place, who will show him the city's hidden treasures. Most are English speaking (though Michael's bilingual Spanish also serves him well) as they introduce him to their passions that characterise these wonderful welcoming cities, revealing rich histories, diverse architecture and food heritages, as well as unknown gems and secret locations you'll never find unless you're really in the know.

name: Что-то положительное
summary: A dreamy high school student, Nastya, is going through all the difficulties of adolescence and escapes from problems by immersing herself in her fantasies. Her parents are busy with her older sister Angelina, who shows great promise, and her younger brother, whom they dote on. She is in love with the charismatic guy Mark, but he does not take her seriously, and even her best friend moves away from the girl. One day, Nastya discovers two stripes on a pregnancy test and realizes that this is a chance to get the long-awaited attention from others. After learning that the test was false, the girl is in no hurry to admit it to her loved ones, step by step plunging into an endless cycle of lies.

name: Ніхто не ідеальний
summary: Before her 18th birthday, Sasha arrives at her uncle's house to become an heiress and get her share of the family business. However, her expectations of a warm and joyful welcome are an illusion. Sasha's arrival ends the peaceful life in the house and causes the secrets of the past to be revealed and a new love story to begin. Some family members are ready to do anything to eliminate the unwanted guest. However, the girl does not back down. She develops her game plan to avenge the offenders and restore justice.

name: Морпехи
summary: They are called "black berets", "black devils", "black death". There are legends about their courage and military prowess. The mere mention of them terrifies opponents. They are the elite of our army. Marines. Sevastopol. Spring. 1975 Black Sea Higher Naval School named after Nakhimov.

name: Running Like a Shooting Star
summary: Qi Tian, a sprinting prodigy with "golden ankles," gave up sprinting for various reasons but returned to the track after entering Xinghe University under the guidance of his senior, Xue Yiran. Together with a group of like-minded friends, they train and compete, gradually overcoming their fear of the racetrack and rediscovering their past hobbies and dreams.

name: Addicted to Love
summary: Su Xingnan, a college student majoring in nutrition, is recognized as the campus goddess of Jiangzuo University. In order to complete the topic of athlete nutrition, she seeks cooperation from her classmate Shao Jingyi. Shao Jingyi's troubles caused her to hit the wall repeatedly. On the way to pursue her dreams, a junior student appeared beside her: He Sen. He Sen is like a patron saint, supporting her dreams and helping her resolve the conflict with her father.

name: Nytt på nytt-quiz
summary: Four of the country's funniest show their best and worst sides. Christian Mikkelsen checks who has caught the most from the week's news.

name: Обіцянка Богу
summary: According to the plot, successful TV presenter Stasya learns that her lover cheated on her with her best friend while pregnant. Devastated by the betrayal of the closest people, she decides not to tell the future father about the child. Time passes, Stasya is happy in her new marriage. However, in a few years she will have to meet with her ex and reveal the secret. Stasi's son is diagnosed with a terrible disease, a donor is needed. But neither Stasya nor the child's father can become one. The umbilical cord blood of a sibling can save a boy. And for this, the biological parents need to give birth to another joint child. This is how the story of the struggle for the life of a little boy begins, which will force all the heroes to rethink life's values.

name: Les Aventures de Colargol
summary: Hector the Rat teams up with his fellow denizens of Pretty Wood, including the titular Colargol (a young girl) and the unimaginatively named Crow (a crow), to head off to Holland. With many musical scenes, the voice actors were chosen for their singing ability above all considerations.

name: Skål, Martha
summary: Martha Leivestad and a guest are served a new type of alcohol in each episode from bartender and sidekick Fetisha Williams to chat, joke and rate the evenings.

name: Golden Axe
summary: Golden Axe follows veteran warriors Ax Battler, Tyris Flare, and Gilius Thunderhead as they once again battle to save Yuria from the evil giant Death Adder who just won't seem to stay dead. Fortunately, this time they have the inexperienced and underprepared Hampton Squib on their side.

name: Lovett or Leave It
summary:
Every Saturday, former Obama speechwriter and self-described "comedian" Jon Lovett is joined live on stage by a killer lineup of comics, journalists, politicians, and celebrities - who may or may not know why they're there - to break down the biggest and dumbest stories in politics and culture.

And now because there's too much news for just one show, join Jon and friends (i.e. beloved producers who have to be there) every Tuesday for a rundown of the latest headlines to help get you through another flawless week in our perfect society.

name: Tender Light
summary: Zhou Luo, a straight-A student, is the first one from Qingshui Town to get into a prestigious university. However, he returns to his hometown before completing his degree and goes to a cram school to repeat a year of school. His decision causes quite a stir in this small town. Had he not faced criticism himself, he would never have noticed another talk of the town, Nan Ya. Nan Ya is a very beautiful clothing store owner, and there are always a lot of rumors about her. She travels between the clothing store and home every day, taking care of her sick daughter, Wanwan. As Zhou Luo becomes more acquainted with Nan Ya, he realizes that Nan Ya's marriage is not a happy one, and her husband, Xu Yi, a businessman, has a brutal side at home. Zhou Luo has witnessed how Nan Ya was assaulted by Xu Yi. Besides, the "Bridge Case" sheds light on several issues regarding Xu Yi's business operations. All this causes Nan Ya's marriage to be in jeopardy. To protect Wanwan, Nan Ya wants a divorce. The kind-hearted Zhou Luo cannot bear to see Nan Ya suffer further, so he offers to help. Finally, with the assistance of Zhou Luo, kind residents of the town, and the police, all parties involved in the case receive fair and just treatment.

name: Star City
summary: Star City is a propulsive, paranoid thriller that takes us back to the key moment in the alt-history retelling of the space race — when the Soviet Union became the first nation to put a man on the moon. But this time, we explore the story from behind the Iron Curtain, showing the lives of the cosmonauts, the engineers and the intelligence officers embedded among them in the Soviet space program, and the risks they all took to propel humanity forward.

name: Mr. Delicious Miss. Match
summary: Story of Ruan Tang, possesses special ability to discern any dish's recipe. She wants to become a food editor, but her father wants her to take over his restaurant and Chen Moyu, a black bellied chef.

name: BBC Two at 60
summary: A selection of iconic shows celebrating BBC Two's Diamond Anniversary.

name: Ved Kongens bord
summary: When Tove is asked to take over as health minister after the previous minister died mysteriously on a business trip in Russia, she is thrown into a dangerous political game.

name: Mysteries of the Pyramids with Dara Ó Briain
summary:
Dara Ó Briain will be joined by archaeologist Raksha Dave and Egyptologist Dr Chris Naunton to explore the most compelling questions surrounding pyramids – 'How were they built using massive chunks of stone, so heavy that even today a modern crane would struggle?' or 'What were the Egyptian pyramid's true function?'; 'If, as Egyptologists suggest, they're tombs, why has no-one ever discovered a Pharaoh in any of them?'    

They will also explore the more far-fetched theories surrounding the pyramids: Was one a giant power station? Were they built for, or even by, aliens? And the biggest mystery of all – why did the Ancient Egyptians start building them and then stop?    

Debunking the many myths that encompass them, this definitive series will uncover the fascinating archaeological, historical, and scientific findings which tell the story of the Pyramids – revealing the secrets of these mega structures –- and will share eye-opening facts that will both surprise and captivate the audience.

name: GPs: Treating Rural Britain
summary: GPs: Treating Rural Britain takes an intimate look at what life is like for the medical teams serving Britain's remote and rural communities.

name: Smärtpunkten
summary: Three long-term violent criminals are incarcerated in the high-security Tidaholm Prison. They want to do theater and contact world-renowned playwright Lars Norén. Together with producer Isa Stenberg, they develop the play Seven Three about the lives of the inmates, with themselves in the roles. They are given permission to perform the play outside the prison. At the same time, a series of brutal robberies are committed. The good intentions soon have terrible consequences.

name: Sengoku Majin GoShogun
summary: Former soldier Shingo Hojo, French spy Remy Shimada, and Bronx gangster Killy Gagley aren't exactly your "hero of justice" types. They'd rather be flirting, bantering, and goofing off than battling evil. But when the malicious worldwide organization Docooga attempts to steal a new, powerful form of energy called Beamler, they'll take up arms to fight them... in the awesome giant robot, GoShogun! Now pursued around the world in their teleporting carrier Good Thunder, GoShogun's piloting team must keep Docooga at bay while foiling their eccentric enforcers, righting wrongs they come across, and occasionally facing ghosts from their own tragic pasts. It's an unexpected combination of drama, satire, and giant robot action like nothing you've ever seen before!

name: Husky
summary: Elle and her mother make a living driving dog sleds with tourists. When the dogs suddenly mysteriously disappear, Elle discovers something that makes her shudder.

name: Gnist
summary: Jenny is willing to sacrifice a lot and go to great lengths to get what she wants. But how far?

name: Давай оденемся!
summary: Designers Katya Dobryakova and Maxim Rapoport talk about beauty and style. They know a lot about both, but they look at the world and the people around them differently. They are a man and a woman, and in their disputes... a beautiful, fashionable and happy heroine of the program is born!

name: Folkets konge
summary: King Harald gives everything for his country, but what has shaped him into the person he is today? And what do we Norwegians think of our king?

name: Lett å hate
summary: Noman is Norwegian-Pakistani, Muslim, and gay. He wants to find out why people hate people like him, and why he is still ashamed of who he is.

name: På tykk is
summary: Six kiters, including an heir to the throne, go on a fantastic communication expedition across Greenland.

name: Ål inn
summary: Ål folkehøyskole is not like other schools. Over the course of a year, we follow pupils and teachers at a school where it is not allowed to use the voice in common areas.

name: Unik - om barn på sykehus
summary: What is it really like to receive treatment in hospital? Series from reality.

name: Луна
summary: The wife and daughter of investigator Nikolay come to a small provincial town to improve family relationships. However, on the very first night, which coincides with the full moon, the father of the family disappears, and the next day his body is found in the forest. Local residents are sure that werewolves are to blame for everything, but the wife of the deceased does not believe in mysticism and begins her own investigation.

name: Lotta
summary: Lotta is a German TV movie series starring Josefine Preuß in the title role, which has been broadcast on Thursdays on ZDF since January 2010. The film series is based on the book Die letzten Dinge (The Last Things ) by Annegret Held.

name: Правила рынка. Хроники российского маркетинга
summary: Representatives of large Russian companies talk about the phenomenon of Russian marketing, discuss its impact on the economy and share their opinion on why data is the new oil.

name: ABC Prime with Linsey Davis
summary: Providing prime-time context and analysis of the day's top stories, as well as in-depth reporting and storytelling from around the country and the globe.

name: ABC News Live First
summary: ABC News Live First will bring streaming viewers the latest headlines, compelling stories, interviews and roundtable discussions.

name: ABC News Live
summary: ABC News Live will bring streaming viewers the latest headlines, compelling stories, interviews and roundtable discussions.

name: America's Sweethearts: Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders
summary: Follow the Dallas Cowboys Cheerleaders from auditions to training camp and the NFL season as they chase their dreams and a coveted spot on the squad.

name: The Resurrected
summary: The Resurrected embarks on a gripping and emotional journey of friendship, revenge and redemption, as they retaliate against the cruel and menacing telescam leader who has captured their daughters.

name: ABC News Live Reports
summary: ABC News Live Reports is the rare national newscast based in Los Angeles, in what the network is billing as an "outside the Beltway" focus on politics for the 2024 election cycle.

name: Home Rescue: The Big Fix
summary: Have you fallen out of love with your home? Do you struggle to find space, stranded in a sea of clutter? Well, take heart. The Home Rescue are here.

name: Evolve
summary: Biologist Patrick Aryee embarks on a high-octane adventure to discover how nature can help us solve humanity's biggest challenges.

name: Botched Bariatrics
summary: Botched Bariatrics featuring patients whose lives have been turned upside down after suffering complications from their bariatric surgery. These patients are in dire need of help, ranging from a woman who can only eat pureed food to a man living with explosive bowels. Doctors and experts in their fields, bariatric surgeons Dr. Khan, Dr. Hodges, and Dr. Rao along with plastic surgeons Dr. Kundu and Dr. Caplin, take on these botched bariatric patients and see if they can undo the mistakes made during their previous surgeries.

name: The UnXplained: Mysteries of the Universe
summary:
Host and Executive Producer William Shatner explores our earth, and beyond, in search of the universe's most fascinating, strange and inexplicable mysteries.

Each episode features contributions from scientists, historians, astronauts and other experts—each seeking to shed light on how the seemingly impossible actually can happen. Seeking answers to age-old questions that have mystified mankind for centuries. Things like, how was our earth born? Will we go back to the moon—or venture even farther? What dangers might lurk in the deep expanse of outer space? And perhaps the biggest of all—are we alone?

previousepisode.name: The Life and Death of the Sun

name: Blue Boys
summary: The drama follows Jaemin, exhausted from job hunting, who finds himself experiencing new emotions after a chance encounter with Nami, an old high school friend. However, misunderstandings about Nami's job lead to conflict. This drama navigates the journey of discovering true love and understanding.

name: Lonely Girls
summary: Mina, who has many friends but is disappointed that no one matches her tastes, begins her first lesbian relationship after being confessed to by her friend Jieun, whom she matched with on a dating app and shares similar tastes with. After reconciliation, they share their true feelings.

name: Long Island Compromise
summary: Long Island Compromise is set nearly forty years after a wealthy businessman was kidnapped and brutalized before his family paid ransom for his release.

name: Last Samurai Standing
summary: In the Meiji era, a fallen samurai enters a deadly tournament to protect those dear to him from relentless foes.

name: Perverso
summary: Haro is a refined and Machiavellian aristocrat who is serving a sentence for rape and murder, and who is threatened with death by a kidnapper who acts against the business elite. Taking advantage of that connection, Haro negotiates prison benefits in exchange for collaborating in the investigation of the kidnappings, although in reality he is preparing his revenge against the judge who imprisoned him.

name: Прометей
summary: Shaposhnikov, a former special services officer, is investigating the case of the disappearance of a passenger airplane in 1998. The past finds echoes in the present when one of the passengers of the disappeared flight calls his family. The case involves journalist Anna, who is used to noticing details that others miss.

name: Consuelo
summary: After her husband leaves without warning, Consuelo discovers selling vibrators can be a way to stay afloat and support her two young kinds, but she must learn to navigate the judgmental waters of 1950's Mexico City.

name: The Porky Pig Show
summary: The tongue-tied pig hosted this collection of Warner Bros. shorts starring himself and his pals, including Daffy Duck and Bugs Bunny.

name: La Partitura Secreta
summary: Maya and her friends find a musical score that grants them magical powers. Together they try to keep it a secret, not knowing that someone with dark intentions is looking for it. As they go on adventures together, they gain a deeper understanding of each other and themselves. Ultimately, they will have to ask themselves if the world is ready for magic.

name: Expedition from Hell: The Lost Tapes
summary:
Expedition from Hell: The Lost Tapes unfolds a stranger-than-fiction story of Mickey Grosman, a former special forces demolitions expert who took a group of amateur adventurers on a nearly impossible journey across South America. Positioned as a charity trek for cancer awareness, participants were to be part of a 5,000-mile expedition across the continent through the deepest parts of the Amazon jungle. Only one claims to have made it to the end…Mickey Grosman.

Expedition from Hell: The Lost Tapes uses the over 700 hours of archival footage shot from the trip to unfold a fascinating series of misfortunes and ineptitudes that quickly turned what was to be an already challenging expedition into a near constant struggle to survive. Tracing the rise and fall (and fall again) of a doomed adventure involving kidnapping, prison escapes, and a missing person, Expedition from Hell: The Lost Tapes uncovers brand new revelations that shock even those who were alongside Grosman during the ill-fated adventure.

name: The End of the World with Beanz
summary: Comedian, writer and traveller Martin Beanz Warde jumps head first into the sustainability and climate action challenges facing Ireland in the hopes of demystifying them for all!

previousepisode.name: Body Image Extremes with Norma Sheahan

name: Dengeler: Biri Olmak
summary: Ferit, who has been dreaming of a completely different life since his childhood, finds himself step by step in a world full of crime, violence, ambition and revenge. Ferit, who has to leave his childish spirit and naivety behind with unrealized possibilities, will sacrifice a lot on the way to "becoming someone".

name: Dundee and the Culhane
summary: A Colt 45, a law book, and a profound sense of justice and fair play define the tools of the trade every Wednesday at 9 p.m. "Dundee and The Culhane," an hour-long color series, brings fresh innovations to the traditional TV western format. Leading the cast is esteemed English actor John Mills, who takes on the role of "Dundee," an English barrister based in San Francisco. Alongside his fiery Irish law partner, "The Culhane," played by Sean Garrison, they journey across the Old West seeking justice for the innocent and delivering punishment to the guilty. The dynamic between these two characters forms the heart of the show. Dundee's calm, resolute sense of fairness contrasts with The Culhane's spirited Irish passion, creating a strong bond reminiscent of Damon and Pythias. Their complementary qualities establish them as two of the most admired figures in the West, earning respect wherever their pursuit of justice leads them.

name: Dumb Bunnies
summary: The Dumb Bunnies are fun loving, helpful and very, very dumb. Through them, kids will learn to look at problems in new ways, remain confident, and never give up. In fact, we will all learn as the Dumb Bunnies turn every day into an opportunity of comic mayhem, adventure and discovery.
